name: progressive-outlining
description: アウトラインから段階的に成果物へ近づける Progressive Outlining (Andrew Ng) を、作業ファイル上の往復と SubAgent による自走で行う。文章向けと設計文書向けの 2 skill

interface.shortDescription: Outline first, then write or design
interface.longDescription: Andrew Ng's Progressive Outlining as a workflow: agree on a brief, pick an outline from several candidates, refine it one level at a time in a shared working file, and only then write the prose or finish the design document.
defaultPrompt: Help me write this article with progressive outlining
